#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the end of quarterly_report.docx (unpacked copy)."""

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import Document  # noqa: E402

doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="6B78E203")

# Run/property formatting used throughout the document
RP = (
    '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
    'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>'
)


def para(text):
    """Paragraph with the document's standard run formatting."""
    return f'<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>{RP}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'


# Anchor: last body paragraph (RISK FACTORS content)
anchor = doc["word/document.xml"].get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")

section = "".join(
    [
        para("RECOMMENDATIONS"),
        para(""),
        para(
            "Based on Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management "
            "recommends the following actions:"
        ),
        para(""),
        para("• Accelerate investment in Cloud Services to build on its "
             "22.8% year-over-year growth"),
        para("• Expand international market presence to support the "
             "10-13% revenue growth target for Q1 2025"),
        para("• Continue operational efficiency programs to sustain "
             "operating margins above 22%"),
        para("• Strengthen customer retention initiatives to extend "
             "customer lifetime value gains"),
    ]
)

doc["word/document.xml"].insert_after(anchor, section)
doc.save()
print("Recommendations section added successfully.")
